title.zh-TW: 終端機工作區支援多個側邊對話分頁，重啟後可重新開啟
title.en: Terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs and reopens saved chats after restart

body.zh-TW: 專案改到一半想順便問其他問題時，單一對話窗往往不夠用。⟦就像在螢幕旁釘上好幾張各自獨立的便條，以前只有一張紙容易互相蓋掉，現在可以各寫各的，重開程式也找得回本機留存的紀錄。⟧只要開啟這個需手動啟用的終端機工作區（支援多個側邊對話分頁的模式），就能同時開出多個側邊對話分頁。例如你正請 Codex 整理一份簡報大綱，順手想再問幾個語法問題，就能另開一個分頁處理。你可以隨時用鍵盤或滑鼠在分頁之間切換，就算把 Codex 關掉重開，先前儲存在本機的側邊對話也還能重新打開。
body.en: When you want to ask unrelated questions mid-project, a single chat pane is often not enough. ⟦Think of it like pinning several separate sticky notes beside your screen: previously one sheet easily got written over, whereas now each holds its own notes and local records stay retrievable after restarting.⟧ Once you turn on the opt-in terminal workspace (a mode supporting multiple side-chat tabs), you can open several side-chat tabs at once. For example, if you have Codex drafting a presentation outline and want to ask a few syntax questions on the side, you can open another tab for that. You can switch between tabs anytime with the keyboard or mouse, and even if you close and restart Codex, previously saved local side chats can still be reopened.

items.original: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)

title.zh-TW: 代理指揮中心新增舊任務搜尋，可依名稱與目錄篩選
title.en: Agent command center adds search for older tasks by name and directory

body.zh-TW: 用過好幾輪 AI 任務後，想回頭找先前處理過的那一筆，往往得在一長串清單裡慢慢翻。現在在代理指揮中心（集中管理各項任務的控制畫面），可以直接搜尋過去的舊任務。你可以用任務名稱或提示詞預覽（當初下指令的開頭內容）來查。如果只記得當時放在哪個專案資料夾，也能直接輸入工作目錄（任務運作的資料夾路徑）搜尋。假設你上週請它幫忙整理會議紀錄，只要打進幾個當時寫的詞，就能立刻把那筆舊任務找出來。⟦好比在手機相簿翻找去年拍的旅遊照，以前得從最新一張一路往上滑，現在只要打地點、相簿名稱或畫面關鍵字就能直接跳到那一張。⟧
body.en: After running several rounds of AI tasks, finding a past item often meant scrolling through a long list. Now, in the agent command center (the control screen for managing tasks centrally), you can search older tasks directly. You can look them up by task name or prompt preview (the opening text of your original instruction). If you only remember which project folder a task lived in, you can also search by entering its working directory (the folder path where the task runs). Suppose you asked it to organize meeting notes last week: typing a few words you wrote then brings that older task right back up. ⟦Picture scrolling through your phone's photo album for a trip from last year: previously you had to swipe up from the newest shot, whereas now typing a place, album name, or visual keyword jumps straight to that photo.⟧

items.original: Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕紀錄可折疊回合細節，保留回覆並支援搜尋工具輸出
title.en: Full-screen transcript folds turn details while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable

body.zh-TW: 對話累積了不少來回步驟後，全螢幕對話紀錄（展開檢視完整往來過程的畫面）常被大量執行細節佔滿版面。⟦想像一份夾著大疊附錄的報告，以前得一頁頁越過查證過程才能看見正文，現在把附錄對折收起來只留結論，真要核對細節時也依然查得到。⟧只要在畫面裡打開 **Collapse turn details**，每次提問底下已經完成的活動就會摺疊收起。當你請它改完報告想順著讀一遍回覆時，AI 的答案依然會直接顯示在畫面上。就算細節收起來了，被折疊的工具輸出（外部工具回傳的執行結果）還是支援搜尋，隨時能翻出需要的片段。
body.en: After a conversation builds up many back-and-forth steps, the full-screen transcript (the expanded view showing the complete exchange) often fills up with execution details. ⟦Imagine a report clipped to a thick stack of appendices: previously you had to flip past pages of verification steps to reach the main text, whereas now folding the appendices away leaves the conclusions visible while still letting you look up details when needed.⟧ Turn on **Collapse turn details** in this view to fold completed activity beneath each prompt. When you want to read straight through the reply after it finishes revising a report, the AI's answers still stay visible on screen. Even with those details tucked away, folded tool output (execution results returned by external utilities) remains searchable so you can pull up any snippet anytime.

items.original: Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557)

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援新增與編輯自訂模型供應商，可透過裝置代碼登入
title.en: Terminal supports adding and editing custom model providers with device-code sign-in

body.zh-TW: 如果你的團隊自架了 AI 服務，或是連到沒有圖形介面的遠端主機，要在終端機設定模型來源往往相當繞路。現在你可以直接在終端機新增或編輯自訂模型供應商（提供 AI 模型的服務窗口）。只要開啟自訂閘道器引導（協助首次連上自訂轉接閘道的設定流程），登入時就能順手建立供應商。當你透過 SSH（安全外殼協定，用來遠端操作主機的連線方式）連線，或是手邊沒有本機瀏覽器時，這個流程就很實用了。只要該閘道器支援，登入時便能改用裝置代碼（在別台裝置輸入即可驗證的短碼）完成授權。⟦跟在飯店電視登入串流帳號一樣，以前螢幕沒有瀏覽器就沒辦法當場開通，現在直接跳出一組配對碼，在手機輸入就能連好自訂來源。⟧
body.en: If your team self-hosts an AI service or connects to a remote machine without a graphical interface, configuring a model source in the terminal used to be roundabout. Now you can add or edit custom model providers (service endpoints that supply AI) directly from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding (the setup flow for connecting to your own relay for the first time) enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in. This flow is handy when connecting over SSH (a protocol for securely operating remote machines) or working without a local browser. When supported by that gateway, you can authorize sign-in using a device code (a short verification string you enter elsewhere) instead. ⟦Signing in works much like activating a streaming account on a hotel TV: without a browser on the screen you could not authorize on the spot before, whereas now a pairing code pops up for you to enter on your phone and link your custom source.⟧

items.original: Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662)

title.zh-TW: 終端機回報編輯器按 Ctrl+S 可本機儲存診斷壓縮檔
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+S in the terminal report editor saves a diagnostic ZIP locally

body.zh-TW: 碰到問題想整理錯誤資訊，偏偏上傳功能被關掉了，資料很容易卡在當下送不出去。現在只要在終端機回報編輯器（用來編輯與送出問題回報的介面）按下 `Ctrl+S`，就能把診斷用的 ZIP 壓縮檔直接存到本機。即使上傳功能處於停用狀態，這組快捷鍵依然可以正常存檔。當你在隔離網路環境下需要留下現場紀錄時，打開編輯器按下 `Ctrl+S`，就能把打包好的診斷檔案留在電腦裡。⟦試想寄件遇上投遞口封閉時，以前整疊資料只能卡在現場送不出去，現在隨時能先封進檔案袋自己收好。⟧
body.en: When you run into an issue and want to gather error details while uploads are turned off, that data can easily get stuck unsent. Now you can press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor (the interface for writing and submitting issue details) to save a diagnostic ZIP archive directly to your machine. Even when uploads are disabled, this shortcut still saves the file as expected. When you need to keep on-site records in an isolated network environment, opening the editor and pressing `Ctrl+S` keeps the packaged diagnostic archive right on your computer. ⟦When a mail drop slot is sealed shut, a stack of papers previously stayed stuck at the counter with nowhere to go, whereas now you can seal them into a folder and keep them yourself anytime.⟧

items.original: Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542)

title.zh-TW: macOS 與 Linux 終端機雲端連線支援傳圖、選模型與封存對話
title.en: Cloud connection on macOS and Linux terminals supports sending images, choosing models, and archiving chats

body.zh-TW: 待在 macOS 或 Linux 終端機工作時，過去連上雲端對話後能調整的項目並不多。只要開啟需手動啟用的雲端連線（從本機終端機接上雲端服務的通道），現在在終端機裡就能直接操作更多項目。⟦彷彿把原本只通簡訊的遠端分機換成全功能桌面，現在圖片寄得過去、推理力道挑得動，談完的紀錄還能順手歸檔或救回來。⟧你可以直接在終端機傳送圖片，也能選擇要使用的模型與推理力度（決定 AI 推敲答案深度的檔位）。當你手邊有一張設計草圖想請雲端模型分析，或是想為複雜問題換個模型時，待在終端機就能一次完成。對話告一段落後，還能順手將雲端對話封存，日後有需要也能再還原回來。
body.en: When working in a macOS or Linux terminal, there used to be few options you could adjust once connected to a Cloud conversation. With the opt-in Cloud connection (a bridge from your local terminal to hosted services) enabled, you can now handle much more right inside the terminal. ⟦An old remote extension that only sent text messages has turned into a full-featured desk: now images go through, thinking depth is selectable, and finished conversations can be filed away or brought back.⟧ You can send images directly from the terminal, and choose both the model and the reasoning effort (the setting that controls how deeply the AI thinks through answers). Whether you have a design sketch for a Cloud model to inspect or want to switch models for a complex question, you can do it all without leaving the terminal. Once a conversation wraps up, you can archive that Cloud chat and restore it later if needed.

items.original: With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651)

title.zh-TW: codex exec 在未受信任目錄停用專案設定，可加 --trust 儲存信任
title.en: codex exec keeps project config disabled in untrusted directories unless saved with --trust

body.zh-TW:
剛接手一個來路不明的專案資料夾時，直接跑自動化任務難免擔心裡頭的設定被擅自啟用。在未受信任的目錄中，`codex exec` 現在會持續停用專案設定與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。就算你同時加上了 `--sandbox workspace-write`（允許在工作區寫入檔案的沙盒權限），這兩項還是不會啟用。若確認該資料夾可以放心，可用 `codex exec` 或 `codex review` 搭配 `--trust` 明確儲存專案信任：

```bash
codex exec --trust
codex review --trust
```

⟦如同陌生訪客來家裡幫忙搬東西，就算你准許他進客廳動手，在屋主正式授權前，屋裡的電器開關依舊全部上鎖。⟧
body.en:
When taking over an unfamiliar project folder, running automated tasks right away raises the concern of its settings being activated without your say. In untrusted directories, `codex exec` continues to keep project configuration and MCP (a protocol that lets AI link to external tools) servers disabled. Even if you also pass `--sandbox workspace-write` (a permission level that allows writing files in the project folder), neither will be enabled. Once you confirm the folder is safe, use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust:

```bash
codex exec --trust
codex review --trust
```

⟦A stranger coming over to help move furniture might be allowed into your living room to work, yet every appliance switch stays locked until the homeowner explicitly grants permission.⟧

items.original: `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041)

title.zh-TW: 清空脈絡並實作會完整交接核准計畫，失敗時保留原工作階段
title.en: Yes, clear context and implement hands off the full approved plan and keeps the original session on failure

body.zh-TW: 討論並核准一份執行計畫後，點選 **Yes, clear context and implement**，就能清空前面冗長的脈絡並直接動工。這個選項現在會把整份核准計畫，完整交接給新開啟的工作階段（單次獨立的對話與執行環境）。萬一交接中途失敗，原本的工作階段也會維持開啟狀態。當你花了不少心思對齊步驟、準備放手讓 Codex 執行時，就能放心按下清空，不怕進到新對話後計畫缺漏，或是交接出錯就兩頭落空。⟦宛如醫院輪班時把整本核定的醫囑交給下一班，要是對方沒順利接手，原本這一班就會繼續留在崗位上不撤離。⟧
body.en: After discussing and approving an execution plan, selecting **Yes, clear context and implement** clears the lengthy prior context and starts work right away. This option now hands the full approved plan over to the fresh session (a single standalone conversation and execution environment). If the handoff fails partway through, the original session stays open. Once you have spent time aligning the steps and are ready to let Codex run, you can clear context with confidence without worrying about missing parts of the plan in the new chat or losing both sides if the handoff errors out. ⟦At a hospital shift change, handing the entire approved chart to the next shift means the outgoing team stays at its post rather than walking away if the handoff falls through.⟧

items.original: **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 沙盒處理引號 cmd.exe 路徑與 PowerShell 權限問題
title.en: Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted cmd.exe paths and PowerShell permissions

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）時，以前只要 `cmd.exe` 的路徑帶有引號，或是 PowerShell 工作階段的工作目錄上層資料夾無法讀取，執行就會出錯。這兩個情境下的 Windows 沙盒處理問題現在已經修好。
body.en: When using the sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts what programs can access) on Windows, execution used to fail whenever a `cmd.exe` path was quoted or a PowerShell session's working directory had an unreadable parent folder. Windows sandbox handling for both scenarios has now been fixed.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647)

title.zh-TW: macOS 貼上圖片保留正確方向，可取用原生 PNG 與 JPEG 資料
title.en: Pasted images on macOS keep their orientation and use native PNG or JPEG data

body.zh-TW: 從 macOS 複製圖片直接貼進對話想請 AI 判讀時，方向歪掉一直很讓人困擾。現在在 macOS 貼上圖片，會確實保留圖片原本預期的方向。只要剪貼簿（暫存複製內容的系統空間）裡本身帶有原生的 PNG 或 JPEG 資料，就會使用這些原生格式。當你從修圖工具或相簿複製好一張直式畫面貼上時，不用再擔心貼進來變成橫躺的。⟦打個比方，拿剛調正角度的相片傳給朋友，以前送過去偶爾會翻倒，現在方向會維持原樣。⟧
body.en: Copying an image on macOS and pasting it into a chat for the AI to inspect used to be frustrating when its orientation came out sideways. Pasted images on macOS now reliably retain their intended orientation. Whenever native PNG or JPEG data is present on the clipboard (the system space that temporarily holds copied items), those native formats are used. When you copy a portrait shot from an image editor or photo album and paste it in, you no longer have to worry about it landing on its side. ⟦Sending a freshly straightened photo to a friend used to flip sideways on arrival sometimes, whereas now it keeps its upright orientation.⟧

items.original: Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455)

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再苦等未回報的 MCP 伺服器，中斷回合收尾更乾淨
title.en: Terminal no longer waits on unreported MCP servers, and interrupted turns close cleanly

body.zh-TW:
操作到一半按下停止或等候外部連線時，偶爾會遇上終端機持續忙碌、甚至誤傷下一輪對話的狀況。⟦猶如舞台剛落幕就該把上一場收乾淨，以前沒報到的名單或晚到的喊卡聲會拖累下一幕，現在這場一停就乾脆收尾，不再牽連下一場。⟧

終端機不再一直忙著等待共用應用程式伺服器未回報的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。共用應用程式伺服器是在背景協調連線的程式。

至於被中斷的對話回合，現在結束得更乾淨。先前延遲抵達的中止指令或檔案核准取消操作，也不會再誤打斷後面的新回合。
body.en:
When you hit stop mid-task or wait on external connections, the terminal can occasionally stay busy or even disrupt the next conversation turn. ⟦Once the curtain falls, the stage crew clears the previous act right away; previously, missing roll calls or late cue-to-stop shouts dragged down the next scene, but now ending one act wraps it up cleanly without spilling into the next.⟧

The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP (the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers that a shared app server did not report. A shared app server is a program that coordinates connections in the background.

Interrupted conversation turns now close more cleanly. Delayed aborts or file approval cancellations also no longer mistakenly interrupt a later turn.

items.original:
The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622)
Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700)

title.zh-TW: 更新 openai-docs 技能與文件，補齊團隊設定與閘道器授權說明
title.en: Updated `openai-docs` skill and documentation with team setup and gateway authorization

body.zh-TW:
剛開始導入工具或替整個團隊統一設定時，官方說明若不夠聚焦，常讓人不知道該從哪份指引看起。⟦好似重新編寫公司的新人報到包，個人剛進門要辦哪些手續、整個部門怎麼統一規矩，連合作窗口怎麼查表都一次寫明白。⟧

`openai-docs` 技能（預先寫好給 AI 查閱的專業知識模組）已經更新，內容改為聚焦在 Codex 與 ChatGPT Work 的相關問題，以及第一次使用 API 的設定步驟，並加入專章說明如何在整個團隊裡統一設定 Codex。

官方也補上了給應用程式伺服器客戶端（連上背景服務進行操作的外部程式）參考的文件，說明如何在不更動預設供應商的前提下，列出已設定供應商的模型或為閘道器授權。
body.en:
When first adopting a tool or standardizing settings for an entire team, unfocused official documentation can leave you unsure where to start. ⟦Rewriting a company onboarding packet makes everything clear at once: what steps a newcomer takes on arrival, how the whole department aligns its rules, and even how partner contacts look up the directory.⟧

The `openai-docs` skill (a prewritten module of specialized knowledge for AI to consult) has been updated to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions as well as first-time API setup steps, and adds a dedicated section on configuring Codex across a team.

Official documentation has also been added for app-server clients (external programs that connect to a background service to operate), explaining how to list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider.

items.original:
Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949)
Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. (#59776, #59819)

title.zh-TW: 內建 SQLite 升級至 3.54 版，納入預寫日誌修復
title.en: Bundled SQLite upgraded to 3.54 with write-ahead log fixes

body.zh-TW: 查看 Codex 這次更新的隨附元件時，你會看到資料庫引擎的版本也有變動。Codex 這次將隨附的 SQLite（輕量級的本機檔案型資料庫）升級到 3.54 版。這次版本更新主要是為了納入預寫日誌（把資料變更先記進日誌檔再寫回主檔的機制）相關的修復項目。⟦正像會計師換用新版流水帳本，把先記草稿再謄進總帳這道工序裡的毛病修好，日常在背後默默把紀錄抄穩。⟧
body.en: When checking the bundled components in this Codex update, you will notice a version bump for the database engine. Codex upgrades its bundled SQLite (a lightweight local file-based database) to version 3.54. This update mainly picks up fixes related to the write-ahead log (a mechanism that records data changes to a journal file before writing them back to the main file). ⟦Just as an accountant switches to a newer ledger, the flaws in jotting down a draft before posting it to the general ledger are fixed, keeping everyday records steady behind the scenes.⟧

items.original: Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432)

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集升級可沿用本機 Git 物件，減少重複下載
title.en: Plugin marketplace upgrades reuse local Git objects to reduce repeat downloads

body.zh-TW: 當你準備替擴充商店更新到最新版時，若每次都得把整包資料從頭抓過一次，總會多傳許多電腦裡早就有過的內容。現在外掛市集（用來瀏覽與安裝擴充功能的商店）升級時，可以沿用電腦裡的既有資料。升級過程中會直接重複使用已經存在硬碟上的 Git 物件（版本控制系統用來保存檔案與歷程紀錄的資料單位），藉此減少重複下載的資料量。當你升級外掛市集時，不必再把已經下載過的內容通通重抓一遍。⟦譬如更換新版百科全書時，以前得整套厚書重寄一箱，現在發現書架上原本就有前幾冊，只要把新頁面補齊就好。⟧
body.en: When updating an extension store to the latest version, fetching the entire bundle from scratch every time transfers a lot of content your computer already has. Now, when the plugin marketplace (the store used to browse and install extensions) upgrades, it can reuse existing data on your computer. During the upgrade, it directly reuses Git objects (the data units a version control system uses to store files and history) already on disk, reducing the amount of data downloaded again. When you upgrade the plugin marketplace, you no longer have to re-download everything you have already fetched. ⟦Replacing an encyclopedia with a newer edition used to mean shipping a whole box of heavy volumes again, whereas now, seeing the earlier volumes already on the shelf, only the new pages need to be filled in.⟧

items.original: Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. (#60528)

title.zh-TW: 挑好新對話的模型供應商，舊對話依然照原設定跑
title.en: Pick a Model Provider for New Chats While Existing Ones Keep Theirs

body.zh-TW: 想替接下來的新工作換成另一家 AI 模型供應商（提供 AI 運算的服務商），現在可以在工作階段選單的「Sessions → Model providers」直接瀏覽清單並指定新對話的預設值。⟦就像幫手機換了預設撥號門號一樣，往後新撥的電話都會走新方案，原本正講到一半或重新接通的通話，則依然留在原本的線路上。⟧你更動新對話的預設選項後，目前開著的視窗與恢復接續的舊對話，都還是會使用各自原本儲存的模型供應商。當你手邊正有一個不想換模型的進行中專案，想讓之後開的新對話改跑別家服務時，就能放心在「Sessions → Model providers」調整預設。
body.en: If you want to switch upcoming work to a different AI model provider (a service that supplies AI computing), you can now browse the list under "Sessions → Model providers" in the sessions menu and set the default for new chats. ⟦Like switching the default dialing line on a phone, future calls go through the new plan, while calls already in progress or reconnected stay on the original line.⟧ After you change the default for new chats, open windows and resumed chats still use their own saved model provider. When you have an active project that should stay on its current model while future chats use another service, you can adjust the default under "Sessions → Model providers" without disrupting it.

items.original:
Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats. (#59541, #59722)
Open and resumed chats use their saved model provider after you change the default for new chats. (#59503)

title.zh-TW: 開啟工作區窗格並排顯示側邊對話
title.en: Enable Workspace Panes to View a Side Chat Beside the Main One

body.zh-TW:
寫主要專案寫到一半想另外查資料，卻不想切走眼前這個畫面時，這個設定就能派上用場。啟用 `features.tui_workspace` 後，就能在主對話旁並排顯示側邊對話。

開啟後，你可以直接拖曳中間的分隔線來調整兩個窗格（畫面裡分割出來的獨立區塊）的大小，或是按下 `leader z` 快捷鍵把目前聚焦的窗格放大查看。⟦試想原本一次只能攤開一本書的桌面，現在擺上活動隔板就能並排對照兩本筆記，推拉隔板即可調寬窄，想專心看哪本也能單獨拉近放大。⟧當你在主對話修改簡報大綱，想順便開個側邊對話查資料又不想切換頁面時，拉寬窗格即可對照，看完再按 `leader z` 放大回主畫面。
body.en:
When you are partway through a main project and want to look something up without switching away from the current screen, this setting comes in handy. Enabling `features.tui_workspace` lets you display a side conversation beside the main chat.

Once enabled, you can drag the center divider to resize the two panes (separate sections split within the screen), or press the `leader z` shortcut to zoom in on the focused pane. ⟦Picture a desk that used to hold only one open book at a time: adding a movable divider lets you compare two notebooks side by side, sliding the divider adjusts their widths, and you can pull either one closer to focus.⟧ When you are editing a presentation outline in the main chat and want to open a side chat to look things up without switching views, widen the pane to compare them and press `leader z` afterward to zoom back to the main screen.

items.original: Enable `features.tui_workspace` to view a side conversation beside the main chat. Drag the divider to resize the panes or press `leader z` to zoom the focused pane. (#58992, #59527, #59595)

title.zh-TW: 支援音訊模型直接夾帶錄音檔對話
title.en: Attach Recordings Directly in Chats with Audio-Capable Models

body.zh-TW: 開完會手邊留著幾段語音筆記，想直接請 AI 幫忙聽並整理重點時，現在可以省下不少功夫。只要選用支援音訊的模型，就能在 Codex 裡夾帶錄音檔一起對話。傳送過程中，已經確定被模型拒收的錄音檔，Codex 在後續幾輪對話會自動跳過不再重複送出。Codex 也會依據每段錄音的長度來計算佔用空間，讓比較多段短錄音能留在上下文（AI 當前記得住的對話內容範圍）裡。⟦好比剪輯師整理桌上的錄音帶，確認被退件的帶子會直接挑到一旁不再送審，短片段則按各自長度緊湊排進桌面，手邊就能多留幾段備用。⟧當你把好幾則簡短的語音備忘錄分批交給支援音訊的模型整理時，既不用擔心無效檔案一再重傳，短錄音也能更多段一起保留在對話脈絡中。
body.en: If you have voice notes left after a meeting and want the AI to listen and summarize key points directly, this saves a lot of effort. As long as you choose an audio-capable model, you can attach recordings in Codex chats. During sending, Codex automatically skips recordings that the model has confirmed rejecting on later turns instead of resending them. Codex also calculates space usage based on each clip's duration, allowing more short recordings to stay in context (the range of conversation content the AI currently remembers). ⟦Think of an editor sorting audio tapes on a desk: rejected reels are set aside so they are never resubmitted, while short clips are packed tightly by length to keep more of them on hand.⟧ When you send several short voice memos in batches to an audio-capable model, invalid files will not keep resending, and more short clips can remain in the conversation context together.

items.original: Attach recordings when using an audio-capable model. Codex skips confirmed rejected recordings on later turns and uses clip duration to keep more short recordings in context. (#59234, #59268)

title.zh-TW: 設定可啟用動態 GIF 圖片生成與編輯
title.en: Enable Animated GIF Generation and Editing via Config

body.zh-TW:
做簡報或回訊息時，有時用一張靜態圖很難講清楚操作步驟，這時候一段會動的示意圖就很有用。啟用 `features.image_generation_animation` 後，就能請 Codex 生成或編輯動態 GIF 圖片。

生成或修改動畫時，你還可以視需要調整影格數量（組成動畫的連續畫面張數）與時間節奏控制。⟦彷彿從單張插畫變成手翻書，以前只能產出一張靜止圖片，現在能自己決定畫幾頁以及每頁停留的節奏，整串連起來就會動。⟧當你需要製作一個示範動圖或調整既有 GIF 的播放節奏時，就能用上這項設定。
body.en:
When making slides or replying to messages, a single static image sometimes cannot explain steps clearly, and a moving visual helps. Enabling `features.image_generation_animation` lets you ask Codex to generate or edit animated GIFs.

When generating or modifying an animation, you can also adjust the frame count (the number of sequential images that make up the animation) and timing controls as needed. ⟦You move from a single illustration to a flipbook, where instead of producing one static picture, you decide how many pages to draw and how long each stays on screen so the sequence comes alive.⟧ Whenever you need to create a demo animation or tweak the playback pacing of an existing GIF, this setting covers it.

items.original: Enable `features.image_generation_animation` to generate or edit animated GIFs with optional frame count and timing controls. (#59073)

title.zh-TW: tmux 全螢幕模式可透過 Ghostty 與 Kitty 顯示圖片與寵物
title.en: Fullscreen tmux Displays Images and Pets on Ghostty and Kitty

body.zh-TW: 習慣把 Codex 放進全螢幕使用的人，如果在終端機裡還套了一層管理視窗，現在終於不用放棄看圖。只要你使用的是 Ghostty 或 Kitty 這兩款終端機，並在 tmux（終端機多工管理工具）裡開啟 `allow-passthrough all` 設定，全螢幕下的 Codex 就能正常顯示圖片預覽與寵物。⟦打開這項轉送功能就像拉開雙層玻璃之間的遮簾，以前多隔一層容器時圖片和寵物會被擋在內側，開通後影像才能透到最外層畫面。⟧當你開著 tmux 工作、想邊做事邊查看圖片預覽或看著螢幕上的寵物時，加上 `allow-passthrough all` 就能把畫面完整呈現在全螢幕裡。
body.en: If you like running Codex in fullscreen inside an extra terminal management layer, you no longer have to give up viewing images. As long as you use Ghostty or Kitty and enable `allow-passthrough all` in tmux (a terminal multiplexer tool), fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets properly. ⟦Turning on this passthrough works like opening the blinds between double-pane glass: previously an extra container layer blocked images and pets on the inside, and opening the path lets them show through to the outer screen.⟧ When you are working in tmux and want to check image previews or keep an eye on pets on screen, adding `allow-passthrough all` renders everything cleanly in fullscreen.

items.original: Fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets in tmux on Ghostty and Kitty with `allow-passthrough all`. (#59579, #59580)

title.zh-TW: 終端機通知支援 osc777 協定並拉長指令預覽
title.en: Terminal Notifications Support osc777 with Longer Command Previews

body.zh-TW:
切換到別的視窗處理事情、等 Codex 回報進度或請示授權時，可以在設定檔將終端機通知設為 `tui.notification_method = "osc777"`，其中 `osc777` 是一種讓終端機發送桌面通知的協定。

需要你放行的核准通知也會變得更清楚。通知裡會顯示更長的指令預覽，並且明確區分究竟是等待終端機輸入，還是請求網路存取。⟦跟汽車中控螢幕一樣，以前儀表板只會亮一顆籠統的警示燈，現在會直接寫明狀況類別，連多一點細節也一併攤在螢幕上。⟧當你專心回信、突然跳出確認通知時，不用切回原本視窗就能先看清指令內容與請求類型，判斷要不要授權。
body.en:
When you switch to another window while waiting for Codex to report progress or request approval, you can set terminal notifications in your config to `tui.notification_method = "osc777"`, where `osc777` is a protocol that lets the terminal send desktop notifications.

Approval notifications that need your go-ahead are also clearer. They show longer command previews and clearly distinguish between waiting for terminal input and requesting network access. ⟦A car's center display works similarly: the dashboard used to light up only a generic warning icon, whereas now it spells out the exact category and puts more details on screen.⟧ When a confirmation alert pops up while you are focused on writing an email, you can see the command details and request type right away to decide whether to approve without switching back.

items.original: Set `tui.notification_method = "osc777"` for terminal notifications. Approval notifications show longer command previews and distinguish terminal input from network access requests. (#59256)

title.zh-TW: 本機歷史與恢復清單依登入帳號篩選新對話
title.en: Local History and Resume Lists Filter New Chats by Account

body.zh-TW: 輪流在同一台電腦登入不同 ChatGPT 帳號的人，要接續先前的進度時最在意各帳號紀錄不混雜。現在本機 TUI（終端機文字介面）的歷史紀錄與恢復對話選擇器，會依據目前登入的 ChatGPT 帳號來篩選新建立的對話串。⟦如同共用電腦裡的個人工作資料夾，以前新建紀錄要自己分辨歸屬，現在會依登入者篩選；換帳號時，新紀錄的篩選依據也跟著換。⟧你之後切換回個人或公司帳號想繼續之前的進度時，打開歷史或恢復對話清單，其中新建立的對話串會依目前登入的 ChatGPT 帳號篩選。
body.en: For anyone switching between different ChatGPT accounts on the same computer, keeping each account's records separate matters most when picking up where you left off. Local TUI (terminal text interface) history and resume pickers now filter newly created threads by the currently signed-in ChatGPT account. ⟦Imagine personal work folders on a shared computer: previously you had to sort out which new records belonged to whom, whereas now they are filtered by who is signed in, and switching accounts switches the filter too.⟧ Later, when you switch back to your personal or work account to continue earlier work, opening the history or resume list filters newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account.

items.original: Local TUI history and resume pickers filter newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account. (#58918)

title.zh-TW: 被工具中斷的回覆合併顯示並還原推理摘要
title.en: Tool-Interrupted Replies Merge Together with Reasoning Summaries Restored

body.zh-TW: 當你回頭檢視先前的對話過程，最怕看到一篇回覆被插進來的工具呼叫切得支離破碎。現在 TUI 介面遇到回覆中途被工具呼叫打斷的情況時，會把整段回答合併顯示成單一則 Markdown（一種用簡單符號排版標題與清單的純文字格式）訊息。重播過去的對話紀錄時，畫面也會把當初的推理摘要（AI 整理出來的思考過程重點）重新還原出來。⟦宛如把講到一半去翻資料的演講稿重新排成一篇完整文章，事後回顧紀錄時，當初附在旁邊的思考重點筆記也會跟著回到原位。⟧當你需要回頭檢查 Codex 之前怎麼一步步得出結論時，整段回答與推理摘要都會連貫地呈現在畫面上。
body.en: When you review an earlier conversation, nothing is worse than seeing a single reply chopped into pieces by mid-turn tool calls. Now, when a reply is interrupted by tool calls in the TUI, the interface merges the whole answer into a single Markdown (a plain-text format that uses simple symbols to style headings and lists) message. When replaying past conversations, the screen also restores the original reasoning summaries (highlights of the thinking process organized by the AI). ⟦Suppose a speaker pauses mid-talk to check notes, and you typeset the transcript back into one continuous article with the margin notes restored beside it when reviewing later.⟧ Whenever you need to trace how Codex reached a conclusion step by step, the full reply and reasoning summaries appear as a continuous whole on screen.

items.original: The TUI renders replies interrupted by tool calls as a single Markdown message and restores reasoning summaries when replaying a conversation. (#59698, #59700)

title.zh-TW: 長跑對話與存檔空檔也能接住引導訊息
title.en: Long-Running Chats and Save Windows Still Catch Steering Messages

body.zh-TW: 任務跑到一半突然想補一句話調整方向，有時剛好會撞上對話收尾或你剛切回視窗的瞬間。現在這種臨時插話的引導訊息（在回合還沒結束時送出、用來修正方向的補充指令），即使剛好在最後儲存對話紀錄的期間送出，或是你暫時切到別處再回到一個跑了很久的對話後才發送，都能順利送達正在執行的回合。⟦猶如列車正準備進站收尾、或你剛走回車廂拿起對講機，駕駛室的通訊頻道依然暢通，臨時送出的改道提醒仍舊接得上。⟧以後看到 Codex 正在長跑、突然想補上修正方向，就算剛切回對話視窗也能馬上送出。
body.en: When a task is halfway through and you want to add a quick note to adjust direction, it can sometimes collide with the conversation wrapping up or the moment you switch back to the window. Now, steering messages (supplemental instructions sent before a turn finishes to adjust direction) still reach the running turn even if sent during the final transcript save or after you switch away and return to a long-running chat. ⟦Even as a train pulls into the station or you walk back into a carriage with a radio, the cab's channel stays open so last-minute rerouting cues still get through.⟧ From now on, if Codex is in a long run and you want to nudge its direction, you can send it right away even if you just switched back to the chat window.

items.original: Steering messages reach running turns when sent during the final transcript save or after switching back to a long-running chat. (#58877, #58998)

title.zh-TW: 模糊搜尋提高檔名吻合的排序比重
title.en: Fuzzy Search Gives Filename Matches More Weight

body.zh-TW: 專案資料夾層數越積越多，輸入幾個字找檔案卻老是被上層目錄的名字搶走前排位置，往往得往下翻好幾行。現在模糊檔案搜尋（只輸入片段字元就能比對路徑的搜尋功能）提高了檔名吻合的排序比重，讓吻合上層資料夾名稱的項目比較不會把目標檔案擠掉。⟦正如在大型倉儲按品名找貨物，以前只要某條走道的區域名稱剛好撞字，整排雜貨就會搶佔前幾行，現在會把箱子本身名稱吻合的先排出來。⟧下次你想快速叫出某個檔案、卻碰巧它的父資料夾名字也帶有相同字詞時，搜尋結果會更容易把你要的檔名留在前排。
body.en: As project folders grow deeper, typing a few characters to find a file often lets parent directory names steal the top spots, forcing you to scroll down several lines. Now, fuzzy file search (a search feature that matches paths using only partial characters) gives filename matches more weight so items matching parent folder names are less likely to crowd out your target file. ⟦Consider searching for goods by item name in a large warehouse: previously a matching aisle name let a whole row of unrelated items crowd the top, whereas now boxes whose own labels match are listed first.⟧ Next time you want to pull up a file quickly and its parent folder happens to share the same word, the search results will more easily keep the filename you want near the top.

items.original: Fuzzy file search gives filename matches more weight so matching parent directories are less likely to crowd them out. (#59709)

title.zh-TW: Windows 閒置本機 MCP 伺服器讓出檔案讀寫通道
title.en: Idle local MCP servers on Windows free up file read and write channels

body.zh-TW: 在電腦背景掛著幾個備用的外接小工具時，就算當下沒用到它們，你也希望其他功能照常運作。現在 Windows 上處於閒置狀態的本機 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，會把資源讓出來。檔案系統 I/O（檔案的讀取與寫入作業）會維持開放，供 Codex 的其餘部分使用。⟦設想共享車道上停著沒在動工的貨車卻曾佔住通行空間，現在只要它停在閒置狀態就會空出車道，讓其餘車輛照常搬運貨物。⟧即使背景還掛著暫時沒在運作的本機工具，Codex 其餘功能依然能順暢處理檔案讀寫。
body.en: When you have a few spare add-on tools running in the background on your computer, you still want everything else to work normally even when you are not using them. Now idle local MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers on Windows yield those resources. Filesystem I/O (file reading and writing operations) stays available to the rest of Codex. ⟦Parked delivery trucks on a shared lane used to block traffic while sitting idle, but now they clear the lane whenever they are not working so other vehicles can keep hauling cargo.⟧ Even with inactive local tools sitting in the background, the rest of Codex can still handle file reads and writes smoothly.

items.original: Idle local MCP servers on Windows leave filesystem I/O available to the rest of Codex. (#59726)

title.zh-TW: app-server 參考文件補齊供應商與雲端閘道設定
title.en: app-server reference adds provider and cloud gateway settings

body.zh-TW: 要把 Codex 串進團隊自己的後端服務或雲端模型時，查閱開發指引是最快上手的方式。現在 app-server（應用程式伺服器，負責在背景處理請求的核心服務）的參考文件，已經涵蓋如何列出模型供應商與建立自訂閘道器。這份文件也說明了如何更新閘道器（統一轉送連線請求的入口）、AWS 的 Bedrock 與 Google 雲端平台 GCP 的設定。⟦比方說買回音響設備時附上一張完整接線圖，從有哪些音源可選、怎麼接自訂轉接盒，到後續怎麼調各家通道參數都寫得清清楚楚。⟧以後團隊要串接 Bedrock 或 GCP 雲端環境，或架設內部模型閘道器時，照著這份參考文件就能直接查到對應做法。
body.en: When connecting Codex to your team's own backend services or cloud models, checking the developer guide is the fastest way to get started. The reference documentation for app-server (the core background service that handles requests) now covers how to list model providers and create custom gateways. It also explains how to update settings for gateways (unified entry points that forward connection requests), AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud's GCP. ⟦Buying new audio gear now comes with a complete wiring diagram that clearly shows which sound sources you can pick, how to hook up a custom adapter box, and how to adjust each channel's settings later.⟧ Going forward, teams connecting to Bedrock or GCP cloud environments, or setting up an internal model gateway, can look up the exact steps directly in this reference.

items.original: The app-server reference covers listing model providers, creating custom gateways, and updating gateway, Bedrock, and GCP settings. (#58845, #58876)

title.zh-TW: 明確設定 features.multi_agent 時提示改用 agents.enabled
title.en: Warning points to agents.enabled when features.multi_agent is explicitly set

body.zh-TW:
曾在設定檔裡寫過 `features.multi_agent` 的人，可能會在畫面上看到一則提醒。只要設定檔裡明確寫了 `features.multi_agent`，Codex 現在就會跳出警告，並指引你想關閉 subagent（分頭幫主代理處理工作的小幫手）工具時要改用 `agents.enabled`。

⟦有如路口多了一張提醒牌，以前照原本的路牌設定路線，現在仍照那塊牌子走時，就會看到提示，告訴你要關閉這條通道該看另一塊路牌。⟧下次看到這個警告時，可依提示查看用來停用子代理工具的 `agents.enabled` 設定。
body.en:
Anyone who has written `features.multi_agent` in their config file may see a reminder on screen. Whenever `features.multi_agent` is explicitly set in the config file, Codex now shows a warning pointing you to `agents.enabled` if you want to turn off subagent (small helpers that handle work for the main assistant) tools.

⟦At a junction where a new sign has been posted, anyone who previously set their route by the old sign and still follows it now sees a notice telling them to check the other sign to close that lane.⟧ The next time you see this warning, you can follow the prompt and check the `agents.enabled` setting used to disable subagent tools.

items.original: Codex warns when `features.multi_agent` is explicitly configured and points to `agents.enabled` for disabling subagent tools. (#59479)

title.zh-TW: 免 BuildBuddy 憑證即可在本機跑 Bazel 測試
title.en: Run Bazel tests locally without BuildBuddy credentials

body.zh-TW: 想替 Codex 送出程式修改的開源貢獻者，寫完程式碼後往往想先在自己電腦確認測試能不能過關。現在貢獻者不需要 BuildBuddy（搭配建置系統使用的遠端測試服務）的憑證，就能直接在本機執行 Bazel 的 CI 任務。這裡的 Bazel 是建置與測試程式碼的工具，而 CI（每次改動後自動跑檢查的持續整合流程）則用來驗證程式修改是否正常。⟦恰似試車手不用先申請遠端賽道的通行證，直接把車開進自家車庫就能先發動跑一圈檢查車況。⟧以後貢獻者想協助修補程式時，不用另外申請遠端憑證，在自己電腦就能跑這套測試工作。
body.en: Open-source contributors submitting code changes to Codex often want to verify on their own machine that tests pass after writing code. Contributors can now run Bazel CI jobs locally without BuildBuddy (a remote testing service used with build systems) credentials. Here, Bazel is the tool for building and testing code, while CI (continuous integration, which automatically runs checks after every change) verifies that the code changes work properly. ⟦Test drivers no longer need to apply for a remote track pass first and can instead pull the car straight into their own garage, start it up, and take a lap to check how it runs.⟧ From now on, contributors helping to patch code can run this test job on their own computer without applying for separate remote credentials.

items.original: Contributors can run Bazel CI jobs locally without BuildBuddy credentials. (#59055)

title.zh-TW: Vertex AI 工具更新預設改為增量傳送
title.en: Vertex AI tool updates are now sent incrementally by default

body.zh-TW:
當你在 Google Cloud 透過 Vertex AI 讓 Codex 串接工具作業時，現在只會同步有變動的部分，不必每次重新傳遞整份清單。⟦就像辦公室登記下午茶訂單，以前有人加點，就得把整張菜單重抄一遍；現在只要回報新增的品項，而且還可以設定關掉，換回原本的做法。⟧如果不想用增量傳送，就打開設定檔 `config.toml`，在 `[features]` 區塊下加入這一行：

```toml
[features]
incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false
```
body.en:
When you connect Codex with tools through Vertex AI on Google Cloud, it now synchronizes only the parts that changed instead of resending the entire list each time. ⟦Picture taking afternoon tea orders in an office: previously, whenever someone added an item, you had to recopy the entire menu; now you only report the newly added items, and you can also configure it off to revert to the original method.⟧ If you do not want to use incremental sending, open the configuration file `config.toml` and add this line under the `[features]` section:

```toml
[features]
incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false
```

items.original: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`. ([#60617](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60617), [#60848](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60848))

title.zh-TW: 代理人指揮中心標記未讀結果，切換後端工作階段保留草稿
title.en: Agent command center marks unread results, and switching backend sessions preserves drafts

body.zh-TW: 平時如果習慣讓多個助理分頭調查專案，終端機現在能讓你清楚掌握每位幫手的最新進度。執行 `codex agents --no-daemon` 就能打開代理人指揮中心，指揮中心與終端機工作階段（session，正在進行中的對話作業）選取器現在都會主動標記出未讀的執行結果。⟦猶如總機櫃台的分機信箱，信件送達時格子會亮起提示燈，即使轉身前往另一張辦公桌交涉，手中寫到一半的便箋也不會遺失。⟧當你在工作階段選取器中切換不同的已連線後端時，輸入框中還沒送出的草稿會完整保留下來，不會因為更換後端就遭到清空。
body.en: If you regularly have several assistants investigate different parts of a project, the terminal now makes it easier to keep track of each helper’s latest progress. Run `codex agents --no-daemon` to open the agent command center. Both the command center and the terminal session picker (for ongoing conversations) now mark unread results. ⟦Like extension mailboxes at a switchboard desk, a compartment lights up when mail arrives, and even if you turn to another desk to discuss something, the note you are halfway through writing stays with you.⟧ When you switch between connected backends in the session picker, any unsent draft in the input box stays intact instead of being cleared.

items.original:
Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框即時預覽附加圖片，逐字稿路徑支援點擊開啟
title.en: Preview attached images in the terminal input box and click transcript paths to open them

body.zh-TW: 在終端機請模型排查版面外觀或分析架構圖時，最怕挑錯要送出的圖檔。現在只要使用支援的終端機，在輸入框撰寫內容時就能直接預覽附加的本機圖片。⟦彷彿在公文夾附上拍立得縮圖，夾上檔案的當下就能先瞄一眼畫面確認無誤，事後查閱歸檔清單時也能隨手按壓標籤快速調閱原圖。⟧而在對話逐字稿（transcript，記錄完整互動內容的文字檔）中，顯示的本機圖片路徑現在也支援點擊，輕點路徑就能直接開啟剛剛檢視過的圖片。
body.en: When asking a model in the terminal to troubleshoot a layout or analyze an architecture diagram, choosing the wrong image to send is a particular concern. On supported terminals, you can now preview attached local images directly while composing in the input box. ⟦Picture attaching a Polaroid thumbnail to a document folder: you can glance at the image as soon as you attach the file to check that it is right, then press its label while reviewing the archive list later to quickly retrieve the original image.⟧ Local image paths shown in the conversation transcript (a text file recording the full interaction) are now clickable too. Click a path to open the image you just viewed.

items.original: Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).

title.zh-TW: 登入選單支援 Vertex AI 設定精靈，切換模型提供者仍可查閱舊紀錄
title.en: Sign-in menu supports a Vertex AI setup wizard, and old chats remain accessible after switching providers

body.zh-TW: 需要連線到不同雲端平台調用模型時，設定登入與管理既有紀錄往往讓人傷腦筋。在「以其他方式登入（Sign in another way）」選單中，可以找到 API 金鑰與雲端提供者選項。只要啟用 `gcp_setup_wizard` 設定項，就能透過引導精靈以應用程式預設憑證（ADC，Google Cloud 用來自動驗證身分的機制）或憑證檔，串接 Google Cloud Vertex AI。⟦如同聘請不同事務所的顧問，櫃台提供制式表單幫你快速登記授權，而先前與上一家顧問往來的會議備忘錄依舊留在手邊，就算無法直接續約也能抄錄結論另開新專案。⟧切換模型提供者後，先前儲存的聊天紀錄依然會留在清單中。如果舊對話無法直接繼續執行，你也可以隨時閱讀歷史逐字稿，並把重點整理成可編輯的提示詞，在全新聊天中直接接續工作。
body.en: When connecting to different cloud platforms to use models, setting up sign-in and managing existing records can be a headache. You can find API key and cloud provider options under the “Sign in another way” menu. Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to connect to Google Cloud Vertex AI through a guided wizard using Application Default Credentials (Google Cloud’s mechanism for automatically authenticating your identity) or a credential file. ⟦Think of hiring consultants from different firms: the front desk supplies standard forms to quickly register your authorization, while meeting notes from your previous consultants remain at hand, so even if you cannot renew the engagement directly, you can copy the conclusions into a new project.⟧ After you switch model providers, previously saved chats remain in the list. If an old conversation cannot resume directly, you can still read its historical transcript and turn the key points into an editable prompt to continue working in a new chat.

items.original:
Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).

title.zh-TW: 審批提示下可展開修補細節，清螢幕保留紀錄且退格不跳指令模式
title.en: Expand patch details during approval, clear the screen while keeping history, and backspace without entering command mode

body.zh-TW:
在終端機審查程式碼修改並輸入回應時，細節檢視與打字體驗迎來了一批順手改進。

跳出審批提示（approval prompt）時，你現在能直接在對話逐字稿中展開修補程式細節。

在終端機整理畫面時，按下 `Ctrl+L` 會清空螢幕顯示內容，先前的對話訊息依然隨時能透過 `Ctrl+T` 叫出查閱。

在輸入框退格刪除文字時，就算露出開頭的驚嘆號 `!`，草稿依然會維持一般對話模式，不再被誤觸成執行外部指令的模式。
body.en:
Reviewing code changes and typing responses in the terminal now comes with several improvements to detail viewing and typing.

While an approval prompt is open, you can now expand patch details directly in the conversation transcript.

When tidying up the terminal view, pressing `Ctrl+L` clears the screen display. Earlier conversation messages remain available through `Ctrl+T` whenever you want to review them.

When backspacing in the input box exposes a leading exclamation mark `!`, the draft stays in ordinary chat mode instead of accidentally switching to the mode for running external commands.

items.original:
Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).
`Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).

title.zh-TW: 支援系統網路代理設定，網路請求逐一排隊審批並明定權限規範
title.en: System proxy settings supported, network approvals queued individually, and permission rules documented

body.zh-TW:
在需要透過特定通道連線或對外部請求有嚴密資安管制的環境中，網路連線行為現在更容易掌握。

現在輸入 `/experimental` 就能選擇加入 macOS 或 Windows 的系統代理伺服器（proxy，協助轉發網路封包的中繼伺服器）設定，讓工具連線直接遵循作業系統的網路轉發規則。

遇到需要手動核准的網路連線時，網路審批提示會在請求結束時自動關閉。多個連往同一個端點的並行請求也不會再同時跳出干擾，而是依序逐一跳出提示讓你確認。

應用程式伺服器（app-server）的說明文件中，也正式補齊了設定檔 `[permissions.network]` 底下的受控網路限制說明，並明列了哪些 `prompt-user` 指令規則必須取得最新的人工審批才能放行。
body.en:
In environments that require connections through specific channels or tightly control external requests for security, network connection behavior is now easier to keep track of.

Enter `/experimental` to opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings (relay servers that help forward network packets), so tool connections directly follow the operating system’s network forwarding rules.

For network connections that require manual approval, the network approval prompt now closes automatically when the request ends. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint no longer interrupt you with simultaneous prompts. Instead, prompts appear one at a time for you to confirm.

The app-server (application server) documentation now also covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` in the configuration file and explicitly lists which `prompt-user` command rules require fresh human approval before they can proceed.

items.original:
Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).

title.zh-TW: Realtime V3 語音自動存入對話歷史，上下文壓縮納入失敗回應產出
title.en: Realtime V3 speech saves automatically to chat history, and context compaction counts output from failed responses

body.zh-TW: 當你進行長時間的即時對話或複雜的多輪問答時，對話內容的完整記錄與記憶管理至關重要。在長期的 Realtime V3 即時語音對話中，隨著逐字稿長度增長，工具會即時將已結束的語音內容保存至聊天歷史記錄中。⟦好比速記員一邊開會一邊將說完的發言謄進議事錄，管帳人員在打包過長卷宗時，也會把印壞的草稿和漏蓋計費章的廢頁通通算入紙張重量。⟧在對話長度過長觸發自動上下文壓縮時，計算機制現在也會如實算入執行失敗回應留下的輸出，以及缺少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量數據的回應。
body.en: When you have long real-time conversations or complex exchanges with multiple rounds of questions and answers, complete conversation records and memory management are essential. During long Realtime V3 voice conversations, the tool saves completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows. ⟦Imagine a stenographer transcribing completed remarks into the minutes as a meeting proceeds, while the bookkeeper packing up overly long files counts misprinted drafts and discarded pages missing billing stamps toward the total paper weight.⟧ When a conversation gets long enough to trigger automatic context compaction, the calculation now also counts retained output from failed responses and responses missing token usage data (the text units AI processes and bills for).

items.original:
Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

title.zh-TW: 淘汰模型主動推薦替代方案，Linux musl 降低閒置記憶體佔用
title.en: Retiring models get replacement recommendations, and Linux musl reduces idle memory use

body.zh-TW:
開發者在維護長期專案或將工具部署在輕量環境時，模型升級與底層資源消耗現在都有更省心的安排。

如果正在使用的模型即將淘汰，內建的 `openai-docs` 技能（skill，擴充 AI 能力的指引包）在引導遷移時，會直接根據官方文件推薦合適的替代模型。

針對安裝部署，DotSlash（按平台自動下載對應執行檔的發布工具）的設定清單現在會直接參照本次版本隨附發布的 Cargo 套件。

若是在 Linux musl 環境編譯，底層改用較少的記憶體配置區（allocator arenas，底層向系統申請記憶體的緩衝區塊），有效降低對話工作階段卸載之後殘留的閒置記憶體。
body.en:
For developers maintaining long-running projects or deploying tools in lightweight environments, model upgrades and underlying resource use now require less attention.

If the model you are using is being retired, the built-in `openai-docs` skill (a package of instructions that extends AI capabilities) now recommends a suitable replacement directly from the official documentation when guiding migration.

For installation and deployment, DotSlash (a tool that downloads the right executable for each platform) manifests now directly reference the Cargo packages shipped with this release.

Builds for Linux musl now use fewer allocator arenas (buffer blocks used to request memory from the system), reducing idle memory left behind after conversation sessions unload.

items.original:
The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).
DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

title.zh-TW: 鍵盤支援選取對話紀錄，按單字換行翻頁與內建搜尋
title.en: Keyboard Transcript Selection with Word, Line, and Page Motions and Integrated Search

body.zh-TW: 查閱終端機裡長串的除錯紀錄時，頻繁移開雙手去抓滑鼠反白文字常常打斷思緒。⟦宛若在厚重字典裡用檢索標籤翻查單字，以前只能用肉眼一行行硬找並手動標記，現在手指一撥就能按章節跳頁並直接定位字彙。⟧對話紀錄（終端機中保留的歷史問答內容）現在完整支援純鍵盤選取操作。你能使用鍵盤按單字、整行或整頁幅度移動游標，精準框選想複製的段落。介面內建搜尋功能，當你請 AI 檢查長篇日誌並想擷取特定段落時，直接鍵入關鍵字就能跳到該行。所有移動與選取的按鍵組合也開放自訂，方便你依照習慣配置個人快捷鍵。
body.en: When reviewing long debug logs in the terminal, frequently moving your hands away to grab the mouse and highlight text often breaks your train of thought. ⟦Think of looking up words in a thick dictionary using index tabs: in the past, you had to scan line by line with your eyes and mark text manually, whereas now a flick of the finger lets you skip across sections and pinpoint a vocabulary word directly.⟧ The transcript (historical question-and-answer exchanges kept in the terminal) now fully supports keyboard-only selection. You can use the keyboard to move the cursor by word, line, or page increments to precisely highlight the passages you want to copy. The interface features integrated search, so when you ask AI to inspect long logs and want to capture specific sections, typing keywords takes you straight to that line. All keybindings for motion and selection are also open to customization, making it easy to configure your personal shortcuts based on your habits.

items.original: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面修復排版與離線退出，還原草稿保留附加圖片
title.en: Terminal Interface Fixes Rendering and Offline Exit While Preserving Image Attachments

body.zh-TW: 在終端機與 AI 密集互動時，文字排版錯亂或突發斷線往往會打亂操作節奏。非同步提問、選項清單、回答內容與對話紀錄回覆中的 Markdown（將文字標記為標題或粗體的輕量排版語法），現在皆能維持一致的渲染呈現。還原被清除的輸入框文字時，原本附加的本機圖片也會一起留下。終端介面也改善了重連後的復原，離線時輸入 `/quit` 或 `/exit` 也能正確處理。
body.en: When interacting intensively with AI in the terminal, garbled text formatting or sudden disconnections often disrupt the operational flow. Markdown (a lightweight markup syntax that formats text into headings or bold text) across asynchronous questions, choice lists, answers, and transcript replies is now consistently rendered. When restoring cleared composer text, original local image attachments are also preserved. The terminal interface also improves reconnection recovery, properly handling `/quit` or `/exit` even when offline.

items.original:
Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292)
Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502)
Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline `/quit` and `/exit` handling. (#57820)

title.zh-TW: 新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型，支援內建與兩大雲端目錄
title.en: GPT-6.1 Terra Model Added with Support for Bundled and Two Major Cloud Catalogs

body.zh-TW: 規劃專案架構並評估模型效能時，能否在自己習慣的雲端託管環境調用最新架構是關鍵考量。⟦好比連鎖量販店引進新型高效冷氣，以前想購買只能透過少數專門管道，現在官方型錄與各大特約通路貨架都同步補齊規格。⟧Codex 模型目錄現已正式加入 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型。除了本地內建的預載型錄外，使用 Google Cloud 的 Vertex AI 或 AWS 的 Amazon Bedrock 託管服務的團隊，也能在各自的模型清單中看到它。在這三份目錄的任一份裡，都能選到 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en: When planning project architectures and evaluating model performance, being able to invoke the latest architecture in your preferred cloud hosting environment is a critical consideration. ⟦Consider a retail chain stocking a new high-efficiency air conditioner: where buyers previously had to rely on a few specialized channels, both the official catalog and the shelves of major authorized partners now carry the model simultaneously.⟧ The Codex model catalog has now officially added the GPT-6.1 Terra model. In addition to the local bundled catalog, teams using hosting services such as Vertex AI on Google Cloud or Amazon Bedrock on AWS can also see it in their respective model listings. You can select GPT-6.1 Terra from any of these three catalogs.

items.original: Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293)

title.zh-TW: 討論串回復與分支保留授權，佇列後可接續，子串一併復原
title.en: Thread Resuming and Forking Preserve Approvals with Queue Resume and Child Thread Restoration

body.zh-TW:
將中斷的工作階段重新接續或另開分支時，對話狀態與先前確認過的設定往往需要被妥善延續。

現在使用 `codex queue --resume` 指令，能在將新訊息加入佇列後，自動喚醒並接續已卸載的討論串。

當你回復既有進度或建立分支時，先前已經過確認的放行批准與權限設定會完整保留，不必在分支裡逐項重新授權。

回復與分支過程也會一併保留推理 token（AI 思考過程消耗的計費文字單位）的累計數據。這避免了系統因遺失思考紀錄而誤判對話長度，導致過早觸發上下文壓縮。

若先前將某個討論串封存，現在只要解封存該父討論串，所有由它衍生出的子討論串都會同步復原。以往分支後總要重新確認權限、子串在解封存時不知去向的麻煩，現在都不會再發生。
body.en:
When resuming an interrupted session or branching into a new fork, conversation state and previously confirmed settings often need to be properly carried forward.

Running the `codex queue --resume` command now automatically wakes and resumes unloaded threads after queueing a new message.

When you resume existing progress or create a fork, previously acknowledged approvals and permission settings are preserved in full, eliminating the need to reauthorize permissions item by item in the branch.

The resume and fork process also retains cumulative counts for reasoning tokens (billable text units consumed during an AI thought process). This prevents the system from misjudging conversation length due to lost deliberation records, which previously triggered premature context compaction.

If a thread was previously archived, unarchiving that parent thread now restores all child threads spawned from it simultaneously. The past annoyances of repeatedly re-confirming permissions after branching or losing track of child threads upon unarchiving no longer occur.

items.original:
Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227)
Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635)
Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839)

title.zh-TW: 安全防護阻擋提示更清晰，提供替代提示詞直接選取
title.en: Clearer Safety-Block Explanations with Direct Selection of Safer Follow-Up Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特定提示詞若意外觸發安全防護，突然中斷的對話常讓人摸不著頭緒。⟦彷彿圖書館珍本庫的借閱櫃台，以前被拒絕調閱只得到一張空白退件單，現在館員會清楚說明受限章則，還會主動列出可借閱的替代篇章。⟧終端使用者介面（TUI，以文字選單排版的終端畫面）現在提供更清楚的安全攔截說明。當你的請求因安全原則遭到阻擋時，畫面會明確解釋被限制的具體原因，不再只丟出一行模糊的拒絕訊息。介面同時會自動生成數個調整過措辭的安全替代提示詞，你可以直接按鍵盤選取並重新送出。這讓你在探索程式碼防護或敏感測試情境時，能立刻知道邊界在哪，並快速調整詢問方向繼續工作。
body.en: When entering certain prompts in the terminal unexpectedly triggers safety guardrails, a sudden conversation halt often leaves users bewildered. ⟦Picture the circulation desk of a rare book library: where a denied request once yielded only a blank rejection slip, the librarian now clearly explains the restricted regulations and proactively suggests alternative chapters available for loan.⟧ The TUI (terminal interface formatted with text-based menus) now provides clearer safety-block explanations. When your request is blocked due to safety policies, the screen clearly explains the specific reason for the restriction instead of merely returning a vague rejection line. The interface simultaneously generates several rephrased, safe follow-up prompts that you can select directly with your keyboard and resubmit. When exploring code defenses or sensitive testing scenarios, this lets you immediately recognize boundaries and swiftly adjust your questioning direction to continue working.

items.original: Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365)

title.zh-TW: 診斷指令新增專注網路選項，快速檢測連線與協定狀態
title.en: Focused Network Option Added to Doctor Command for Rapid Diagnostics

body.zh-TW:
當終端機突然連不上伺服器或回覆中斷時，快速抓出是本機環境還是網路連線出問題至關重要。⟦如同音響工程師拿著導線專用測試儀，以前排查雜音得把整套擴大機與調音台拆開通盤安檢，現在只要接上線頭就能單獨測量訊號導通狀況。⟧現在診斷工具新增了 `codex doctor --network-only` 參數選項。這項指令只針對設定、連線能力與 WebSocket（雙向即時通訊的網路協定）狀態做診斷。當你在公司內部網路或代理伺服器環境下遭遇請求逾時，只要打：

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

終端機就會只回報設定、連線與 WebSocket 這三項的檢查結果。
body.en:
When the terminal suddenly loses connection to the server or replies are cut off, quickly pinpointing whether the issue lies in the local environment or the network connection is critical. ⟦An audio engineer uses a dedicated cable tester: whereas troubleshooting noise previously required dismantling and inspecting the entire amplifier and mixing console, plugging in the leads now immediately tests signal continuity on its own.⟧ The diagnostic tool has now added the `codex doctor --network-only` option. This command runs diagnostics exclusively on configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket (a networking protocol for bidirectional real-time communication) status. When encountering request timeouts in corporate intranets or proxy environments, you simply run:

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

The terminal then reports only the configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket checks.

items.original: Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

title.zh-TW: 獨立執行器隨附於正式安裝包，整頓背景服務與建置工具
title.en: Standalone Executor Shipped in Official Packages Alongside Service and Build Improvements

body.zh-TW: 在建置環境部署與升級工具時，底層架構的打包完整度與資源釋放直接影響執行穩定。正式釋出的命令列工具與 app-server（應用程式背景伺服器）安裝包中，現在已直接隨附獨立執行器。背景服務修復了執行緒啟動與關閉時的競爭衝突，執行完成後會即時釋放占用資源。同時，macOS 上若安裝路徑包含中文等非 ASCII 字元，或程式仍在使用中，獨立版本的清理錯誤也已修好。在專案建置方面，Bazel 改採原始碼自編譯的 V8 引擎，搭配相符的 Rust 綁定並支援 Windows 原生 MSVC 封裝；開發與正式發行版本也全面標準化至 Node.js 24.22.1 與 Rust 1.95.0。以往在特定路徑清理失敗或背景程序殘留資源的問題，現在都已排除。
body.en: When deploying and upgrading tools in build environments, the packaging integrity and resource release of underlying architectures directly dictate execution stability. Canonical CLI and app-server (application background server) release packages now bundle the standalone executor directly. The background service fixes thread startup and shutdown races, promptly releasing occupied resources upon completion. Meanwhile, standalone release cleanup errors on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters such as Chinese have also been resolved. For project builds, Bazel switches to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. Development and release builds are also standardized across the board on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. Past issues where cleanups failed on specific paths or background processes left lingering resources are now eliminated.

items.original:
Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

title.zh-TW: 內建 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者，支援 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
title.en: Built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI Provider and Support for GPT-6.1 Terra

body.zh-TW:
如果你習慣使用 Google Cloud 部署各項服務，現在可以直接透過 Vertex AI 調用模型，不用再自己撰寫複雜的轉接外掛。

設定檔只要加入：

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

就能直接切換為內建的 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者。同時，官方模型清單也加入了最新推出的 GPT-6.1 Terra，讓你在挑選模型時有更多元的運算選擇。

⟦宛如到連鎖租車行租賃商務車隊，以前想開特定廠牌還得自己找外包車行簽約，現在官方直接納入特約合作名單，還同步上架了最新款旗艦房車供你自由挑選。⟧

當你著手建置企業內部應用，想把 AI 運算統一收整在既有的 Google Cloud 專案與帳單下，只要在設定檔指定 `gcp`，就能立刻連接 Vertex AI 資源；需要測試最新模型能力時，也能直接在清單中選用 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en:
If you are used to deploying services on Google Cloud, you can now call models directly through Vertex AI without writing complex adapter plugins yourself.

Simply add the following to your configuration file:

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

This directly switches to the built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider. At the same time, the official model catalog now includes the newly released GPT-6.1 Terra, giving you more computing options when choosing models.

⟦Picture renting a commercial fleet from a car rental chain. In the past, driving a specific brand required finding and contracting with outside agencies on your own. Now the company directly adds them to its partner roster and puts the latest flagship sedan in the lineup for you to choose from.⟧

When building internal enterprise applications and consolidating AI compute under existing Google Cloud projects and billing, you only need to specify `gcp` in the configuration file to connect to Vertex AI resources immediately. When you need to test the latest model capabilities, you can also select GPT-6.1 Terra directly from the catalog.

items.original:
Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265)
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段選擇器支援儲存庫篩選，指令中心依目錄分組
title.en: Session Picker Supports Repository Filtering, Agent Command Center Groups by Directory

body.zh-TW:
當你同時在多個專案副本間切換工作時，要在落落長的工作階段清單裡找出剛剛開啟的對話往往得費一番工夫。

在搭配 Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）進行多工處理時，工作階段選擇器現在加入了儲存庫篩選機制，你可以快速過濾出屬於特定專案的工作階段。

⟦好比大型檔案庫整頓借閱卡，以前所有專案的借閱單全塞在同一個抽屜，找紀錄得一張張比對；現在能按專案名稱抽取專屬卡盒，櫃台還會按實體檔案夾分層收納。⟧

代理指令中心也同步支援目錄分組，會將關聯在同一工作樹目錄下的所有紀錄整合在一起，讓跨副本的工作階段瀏覽井然有序。當你一邊在主專案修復問題，另一邊在副本測試新功能時，只要開啟選擇器輸入專案名稱，就能切回目標對話，不再被其他專案的工作階段干擾。
body.en:
When juggling work across multiple project copies, locating a recently opened conversation in a long session list often takes considerable effort.

When multitasking with Git worktrees (a feature allowing multiple copies of the same project in parallel), the session picker now includes a repository filter, allowing you to quickly filter out sessions belonging to a specific project.

⟦Imagine a large archive reorganizing its checkout slips. Previously, slips from all projects were stuffed into a single drawer, forcing you to check records one by one. Now you can pull out a dedicated card box by project name, and the desk organizes them into tiers by physical folder.⟧

The agent command center now also supports directory grouping, bringing together all records associated with the same worktree directory to keep session navigation across copies neat and orderly. When you are fixing an issue in the main project while testing a new feature in a copy, you can simply open the picker and type the project name to switch back to the target conversation without distraction from other projects' sessions.

items.original: Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器 API 支援附加對話分支，實驗性拆分子討論串
title.en: App-Server API Supports Experimental Attached Thread Forks

body.zh-TW:
如果你正在透過應用伺服器介面開發專屬工具，想在同一個對話脈絡下嘗試不同解法時，管理獨立分支往往相當繁瑣。

`app-server` 的 API 現在加入了實驗性的附加對話分支（從既有對話衍生出附屬子討論串的機制）。這項功能讓應用程式能直接從既有對話拆出分支，既完整保留主線累積的上下文，又不會讓測試過程弄亂原本的紀錄。

⟦恰似在活頁筆記本貼上延伸標籤頁，以前想嘗試第二種草案只能整本重新謄寫，現在直接在關鍵頁面夾入附屬便箋，既保留原有筆記的脈絡，寫壞了也能隨時抽換。⟧

當你需要讓使用者對同一個問題評估多種修改方案時，就能透過這組介面拉出附屬討論串進行推演，讓主線對話隨時維持乾淨。
body.en:
If you are developing custom tools through the app-server interface and want to try different solutions within the same conversational context, managing separate branches can often be cumbersome.

The `app-server` API now includes experimental attached thread forks (a mechanism for branching secondary sub-threads from an existing conversation). This feature allows applications to branch directly off an existing conversation, preserving the full context accumulated in the main thread while preventing experiments from cluttering original records.

⟦Think of attaching extension tabs to a loose-leaf notebook. Previously, trying a second draft meant rewriting the entire notebook from scratch. Now you insert an attached memo directly into key pages, preserving the original context while letting you swap out bad drafts at any time.⟧

When you need users to evaluate multiple revision options for the same issue, you can use this interface to spin off secondary threads for exploration while keeping the primary conversation completely clean.

items.original: Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)

title.zh-TW: 支援對話途中調整思考力度，預設開放動態切換
title.en: Support for Adjusting Reasoning Effort Mid-Conversation, Enabled by Default

body.zh-TW:
向 AI 提問時如果一開始只隨口聊聊，隨後卻突然碰上需要抽絲剝繭的複雜架構，往往會受限於最初設定的思考程度。

針對有支援的模型，現在已經預設允許在對話途中直接修改思考力度（決定模型在回答前投入多少推理運算的參數）。你不再需要為了讓 AI 想得更深入而特地中斷對話另開新局，交談到一半隨時能依照問題難度靈活增減思考量。

⟦跟下西洋棋時切換思考時限一樣，以前開局選了快棋就只能一路快打到底，現在遇到膠著局面能當場多要幾分鐘長考，解開難題後又能切回節奏，不必把整盤棋推倒重來。⟧

當你原本只是請它解讀一段日常日誌，中途突然想探討分散式鎖的死結原因時，就能當場調高力度，讓模型針對核心邏輯進行深度推理。
body.en:
When asking an AI questions, starting with casual chat and then suddenly running into a complex architecture that demands deep dissection often leaves you constrained by your initial thinking depth.

For supported models, changing reasoning effort (the parameter determining how much reasoning computation the model invests before answering) during a conversation is now enabled by default. You no longer need to interrupt the conversation and start a new session just to make the AI think more deeply; you can flexibly adjust the amount of thinking midway based on question complexity.

⟦A chess clock adjustment reflects this transition. Previously, choosing blitz at the opening meant rushing through the entire match. Now, when a stalemate strikes, you can claim a few extra minutes on the spot to think deeply, then switch back to your normal pace once the puzzle is solved without resetting the board.⟧

When you initially ask it to interpret a routine log and suddenly decide to explore the root cause of a distributed lock deadlock midway through, you can increase the effort on the spot to let the model perform deep reasoning on the core logic.

items.original: Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)

title.zh-TW: 新設定檔預設啟用第二代記憶，支援匯入外部代理記憶
title.en: Fresh Profiles Enable Memory v2 by Default with Support for Importing External-Agent Memories

body.zh-TW:
每次建立新的個人設定檔時，如果希望 AI 能記住你的偏好或從其他工具轉移習慣，往往需要不少手動設定。

現在建立全新設定檔時，工具會預設啟用第二代記憶架構（讓工具跨對話保存使用者偏好的機制）。這套架構也同步支援匯入外部代理的記憶資料，能直接讀取其他 AI 工具先前累積的偏好與操作紀錄。

⟦如同搬進全新裝潢的智慧住宅，以前每次換新家都要重新訓練管家認識你的生活作息，現在進門就有現成的智慧管家隨時待命，還能直接把前任管家的備忘手冊整本讀取完畢。⟧

當你從其他開發助理切換到 Codex 時，不用再從頭教它你的排版風格與常用語法，只要把既有的記憶檔匯入，新設定檔就能立刻依循你的慣用模式工作。
body.en:
Whenever you create a new profile, having the AI remember your preferences or transfer habits from other tools usually requires considerable manual setup.

When creating fresh profiles, the tool now enables memory v2 (a mechanism allowing the tool to preserve user preferences across conversations) by default. This architecture also supports importing external-agent memories, directly reading preferences and operational logs accumulated in other AI tools.

⟦Consider moving into a newly renovated smart home. Previously, each move meant retraining a butler to learn your daily routine. Now, a ready-made smart butler is on standby the moment you enter, capable of reading through your previous butler's entire memo notebook.⟧

When switching from another coding assistant to Codex, you do not need to reteach your formatting style and preferred syntax from scratch; simply import your existing memory files, and the fresh profile will immediately work according to your established habits.

items.original: Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面在參數錯誤時保持可編輯，新工作階段沿用預設審核者
title.en: TUI Preferences Remain Editable on Invalid Settings, Fresh Sessions Honor Default Reviewer

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面操作工具時，如果遇到執行參數填寫錯誤，偏好設定選單一旦被連帶鎖死，往往會讓人動彈不得。

針對終端使用者介面（以純文字排版的終端機視窗），現在即便執行設定中存在無效參數，偏好設定依然保持可編輯狀態，且修改後能立即生效。新開啟的終端工作階段在未提供明確覆寫時，現在也會確實遵循伺服器的預設審核者規則。

⟦彷彿汽車儀表板的設定選單，以前只要感測器回報異常數值，整個操作面板就跟著卡死無法調整；現在各項控制選項依然能隨意修改並即時生效，新發動的車輛也會主動遵循車隊預設的安全指派。⟧

無論是不慎輸入了無效路徑，或是剛啟動全新的終端對話，介面都不會再無故罷工，各項審核權限也能正常運作。
body.en:
When operating tools in a terminal interface, if execution parameters are entered incorrectly and the preference menu freezes as a result, you are often left stuck.

For the terminal user interface (a text-based terminal display), preferences now remain editable and take effect immediately even when invalid parameters exist in execution settings. Fresh terminal sessions also properly honor the server's default approval reviewer rules when no explicit override is provided.

⟦The settings menu on a car dashboard mirrors this behavior. In the past, whenever a sensor reported an abnormal reading, the entire console froze and prevented adjustments. Now control options remain fully editable with immediate effect, and newly started vehicles actively follow default safety assignments set by the fleet.⟧

Whether you accidentally enter an invalid path or just launched a brand new terminal conversation, the interface will no longer freeze without cause, and approval permissions continue to function normally.

items.original:
Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)

title.zh-TW: 中斷與取消時即刻停止背景運算，模型找不到不再盲目重試
title.en: Promptly Stop Background Tasks on Interrupt and Cancellation, Stop Blind Retries for Missing Models

body.zh-TW:
當你在操作過程中按下停止或遇到無效請求時，背景程式如果持續空轉或重複嘗試，往往會白白消耗運算資源與等待時間。

⟦有如辦公大樓的撤銷派工機制，以前專案喊停後外包廠商依然繼續趕工，送錯地址的公文還在不斷重複投遞；現在只要前端發出取消通知，所有外派作業與無效配送都會立刻剎車。⟧

第一項改動針對遠端 MCP 工具（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）。如果本機端已經取消或不再等待回傳結果，會主動向遠端發送取消通知，避免遠端伺服器徒勞運算。

第二項調整落在代理訊息排隊機制。當你在對話中按鍵中斷執行，或是切換到計畫模式時，已排隊的訊息不會再擅自重啟工作。

第三項改動則是在模型提供者回報找不到指定型號時，工具會立即停止重複嘗試，並完整保留原本的錯誤訊息。

以前遇到操作中斷或設定失效時，背景可能會持續重試或再度喚醒任務，現在各項失效請求都能及時收手。
body.en:
When you press stop during an operation or encounter an invalid request, background processes that continue idling or repeatedly retrying waste computing resources and waiting time.

⟦An office building's dispatch cancellation mechanism works in much the same way. Previously, contractors continued rushing work after a project was halted, and misaddressed documents were repeatedly redelivered. Now, once the front desk issues a cancellation notice, all dispatched tasks and invalid deliveries brake immediately.⟧

The first change applies to remote MCP tools (protocols that connect AI to external tools). If the local side has cancelled or no longer waits for returned results, it actively sends a cancellation notice to the remote side, preventing remote servers from wasting compute.

The second adjustment targets the agent message queuing mechanism. When you press a key to interrupt execution during a conversation or switch to Plan mode, queued messages will no longer restart work without permission.

The third change stops retrying immediately when a model provider reports that a specified model was not found, fully preserving the original error message.

Previously, when operations were interrupted or settings failed, background processes might continuously retry or wake tasks back up; now invalid requests cease promptly.

items.original:
Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)

title.zh-TW: 市集網址驗證補強防護，防範 Git 連線至未經授權的主機
title.en: Marketplace URL Validation Strengthened to Prevent Git Connecting to Unauthorized Hosts

body.zh-TW:
從擴充市集下載外掛或套件時，工具能否嚴格把關下載來源，攸關整個開發環境的安全。

市集網址的驗證機制現在補上了防護漏洞。以往在比對網址時存在落差，可能導致 Git 最終連線的主機，與安全名單中所允許的主機並不一致。這個驗證漏洞已經補上，Git 不會再連到與允許名單所檢查的不同主機。

⟦猶如社區門禁核對訪客名單，以前警衛登記的地址和訪客實際去的地方可能對不上，現在這個對不上的漏洞已經補上。⟧

這個問題已經修好，安裝市集套件時不會再因網址歧異而誤連至未授權的外部主機。
body.en:
When downloading plugins or packages from an extension marketplace, whether a tool strictly verifies download sources is vital to the security of your entire development environment.

The marketplace URL validation mechanism has now closed a security gap. In the past, discrepancies during URL matching could cause Git to ultimately connect to a different host from the one permitted on the safe list. This validation gap has been closed, ensuring Git will no longer connect to a host different from the one checked against the allowlist.

⟦Checking visitor logs at a gated community entrance reflects this safeguard. Previously, the address recorded by a guard might not match where a visitor actually went; now this mismatch loophole has been firmly closed.⟧

This issue has been fixed, so installing marketplace packages will no longer inadvertently connect to unauthorized external hosts due to URL discrepancies.

items.original: Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)
